An '''entertainment holocube''' was a form of recreational entertainment. These type of [[Holocube/Legends|holocubes]] were issued to [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]]' [[Green squad]] during their long-term assignment to monitor communications from the [[Imperial Communications Center (Iyuta)|Imperial Communications Center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iyuta]].<ref name="Missing">{{WEGCite|story=Lens Reekeene Is Missing|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>
